title: docs(adr-0135): with SSO domain verification on, a provider creates an account only at a domain it has proven

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUUpFMVmsGPYA9eoB2zGSrV)_

Supersedes #32638.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:更正 ADR-0135“域名验证”一段:验证覆盖提供方列出的每个域名、改动域名列表会清除验证;开启验证后,提供方只能为其已证明的域名下的邮箱新建账号,精确比较,失败即拒,任何受众姿态、邀请或 JIT 开关都不放宽,已有账号不复查。本轮给两句规则补上指向代码的符号锚点,并在 D6 下加注记:这条规则是本仓自定、已获你批准,由 #32669 实现。
- 为什么改:设计文本须与代码 PR #32669 的规则一致;ADR-0135 要求每条机制陈述带符号锚点,方便不进 cloud 仓也能核对。
- 风险与回滚:仅文档,`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H 受管面,不发布任何包;回滚即还原本 PR。新锚点指向 #32669 新增的文件,所以 #32669 合并前 `check:adr-symbol-anchors` 会红,这是有意为之,用门禁保证落地顺序。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` 中 "Domain verification is opt-in" 一段(唯一改动)。
- 两分钟验证:#32669 合并后运行 `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`,预期 0 个发现。
- 需要你做的:规则本身你已于 2026-11-13 批准(无例外,网址写法不兼容),ADR 的 D6 注记已写明;剩下作为 Tier H 受管面,审阅并批准(或亲手合并)本 PR,时间在 #32669 合并之后。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md`, the "Domain verification is opt-in" paragraph, states what verification guarantees:

- the DNS-TXT proof covers every domain a provider lists, a provider signs nobody in until that list is proven, and editing the list clears the proof;
- with verification on, where the platform admits a new account, a provider creates an account only for an email address at a domain it has proven, compared exactly (a subdomain counts only when it is itself listed and verified, and a listed entry counts only for the host the provider proved), failing closed, and relaxed by no audience posture, invitation or JIT toggle; accounts that already exist are not re-checked;
- with the rule that a domain is claimed by one provider at most, held where a provider is registered and where its domain list is edited, an SSO provider creates a new account at a domain only when it is the one provider that claims that domain and has proven it.

The two rule sentences carry symbol anchors (ADR-0135 Provenance point 2): `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.ts#refuseSsoAccountOutsideProvenDomain` and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-provider-lifecycle.ts#findSsoDomainClaim`.

**Whose rule this is.** The exact comparison and the "no posture, invitation or JIT toggle relaxes it" clause are a rule made in this repository, not text carried from cloud ADR-0024. The ADR now says so in a dated note under D6, and "What this record does NOT settle" names that note as the one exception to "this file adds no clause". The maintainer ruled on it on 2026-11-13 (approved, no carve-out; a domain entry counts only when written as a bare host), and the note records that ruling and names #32669 as the PR that implements it.

The code that holds the rule, its tests, the code comments and `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` land in #32669. This PR is separate because `docs/adr/**` is a Tier H governed surface.

## Tests

None: documentation only.

## Acceptance notes

- The first anchor names a file that #32669 adds, so `check:adr-symbol-anchors` answers one `unresolved-path` finding until #32669 is on `main`. That red is the landing order held by a gate: this PR lands after #32669. The second anchor resolves on `main` today.
- No decision is reversed: the paragraph keeps D6 opt-in and off by default.
